title: Day 1 of building a game with the community.
author: SlopToShip
selftext:
I thought of a little experiment I wanted to do where I take a game from slop to shipped with the help of top comments across social medias. I'll document the prompts, changes, additions, bugs, everything along the way.

I do not expect this to go well with the current wave of AI hate but I couldn't help myself.

The video I made for it - https://www.youtube.com/shorts/a2cTPuFD79I

I'm also working on my own projects (already on steam) - so this'll go right into my workflow no problem, assuming it goes anywhere.

If you think this might be an interesting experiment, I'd love to hear your ideas! Lets talk about what type of game we should start out with!
